escalation_ladder.principle: Each new act must replace the previous threat with a strictly worse one, not add another of the same kind.
escalation_ladder.use_in_our_film: Replace threats with structurally worse ones at each act break.

frame_narrative.principle: Story told after events by survivor gains elegiac weight; exposition as confession.
frame_narrative.use_in_our_film: Tight frame: protagonist's voice-over, present tense, addressed to unknown listener.

midpoint_reveal_as_moral_fact.principle: Midpoint reveal should not be a monster but a fact that retroactively re-reads every earlier scene as sinister.
midpoint_reveal_as_moral_fact.use_in_our_film: Plan a midpoint fact (not a monster) that re-reads the first half.

open_ending_as_technique.principle: Truncation can be deliberate (Pym); soft resolution (Prendick's retreat) also works.
open_ending_as_technique.use_in_our_film: Earned closure for protagonist's arc; leave larger world ambiguous but not unresolved.

suspense.withholding_information: Give reader only what protagonist knows; make host environment know more than guest.
suspense.foreshadowing_small_wrongness: Three small wrong details early pay off as one big reveal at midpoint.
suspense.false_assumptions: Let protagonist be wrong twice before being right.
suspense.mystery_escalation: Each chapter answers one question and raises a bigger one.
suspense.betrayal_through_kindness: Most painful betrayals by people who were kind first.
suspense.cliffhanger_discipline: End scenes on discovery or scream, not sigh.

character_design.credible_ya_protagonist: Educated/observant + specific practical skill + credible weakness (impulsivity, fainting, hesitation, attachment to lost friend).
character_design.agency_curve: Protagonist starts reactive, becomes proactive in middle, ends decisive.
character_design.supporting_cast_diversity: Each supporting character has independent motive; women have their own goals.

scene_craft.scene_objectives: Each scene answers one question or achieves one physical goal.
scene_craft.visual_storytelling: Deprive senses (darkness, silence, color) to make images cinematic and cheap to render.
scene_craft.dialogue_economy: Use companion's questions as exposition prompts.
scene_craft.pacing: Tight in thriller core; slow in reflective interludes.
